title: SharkTank
tagline: AI powered app to judge the projects for investors to see fit
description:
Core Concept
An AI-driven platform that evaluates startup projects and investment opportunities, providing investors with data-backed assessments to make informed decisions. Think of it as a "due diligence co-pilot" that analyzes projects across multiple dimensions.
Key Features & Functionality
Automated Project Analysis

Upload pitch decks, business plans, and financial projections for instant AI evaluation
Multi-criteria scoring across team strength, market opportunity, product viability, financial health, and competitive positioning
Natural language processing to extract key insights from documents and presentations

Real-time Risk Assessment

Market risk analysis using live data feeds and trend analysis
Technical feasibility scoring for tech-focused projects
Financial modeling and burn rate projections
Competitive landscape mapping

Comparative Intelligence

Benchmark projects against similar successful/failed ventures in the same sector
Pattern recognition from historical investment outcomes
Portfolio fit analysis - how well does this align with investor's existing holdings

Smart Matching

Match projects to investor preferences, thesis, and risk appetite
Alert system for high-potential opportunities in preferred sectors
Collaborative filtering based on what similar investors have backed

Due Diligence Automation

Background checks on founding team using public data
Verification of claims in pitch materials
Legal and compliance red flag detection
IP and patent landscape analysis

Technical Architecture
Frontend: Clean dashboard showing scored projects, detailed breakdowns, comparison tools
AI Models: Combination of NLP for document analysis, predictive models for success probability, computer vision for pitch deck analysis
Data Sources: Market databases, regulatory filings, news APIs, social signals, financial data providers
how_its_made:
How It's Made
Our investment analysis platform combines cutting-edge AI with blockchain verification to create a transparent, trustworthy evaluation system.
Core Tech Stack:

Frontend: React.js with TypeScript for type safety, Tailwind CSS for responsive UI, Recharts for data visualization dashboards
Backend: Node.js with Express, Python FastAPI for AI model serving
AI/ML Layer: OpenAI GPT-4 for document analysis and insight extraction, custom fine-tuned models for investment scoring, LangChain for orchestrating multi-step analysis workflows
Blockchain Integration: Smart contracts deployed on Metis Andromeda for immutable scoring records and audit trails, ensuring investors can verify analysis wasn't tampered with post-facto
Database: PostgreSQL for structured data, Pinecone vector DB for semantic search across historical deal data
